# Reveal Market

> Privacy-first prediction markets with commit-reveal rails, signed pricing quotes, and on-chain settlement receipts. Public pages cover product overview, partner docs, and market listings.

Use this file to navigate public content. Do not use private or authenticated content, user-specific dashboards, or private data feeds.

## Docs
- [Docs overview](https://revealmarket.xyz/docs): Entry point for platform, architecture, and roadmap.
- [Getting started](https://revealmarket.xyz/docs/getting-started): Setup, funding, quotes, commit, claim.
- [Privacy & security](https://revealmarket.xyz/docs/privacy-security): Threat model, privacy guarantees, and controls.
- [API reference](https://revealmarket.xyz/docs/api): REST endpoints, caching, and rate limits.
